comment: The LIMR is said to ensure that data is machine-processable rather than locked in free text. Clinical free text remains valuable, and forcing all relevant information into structured models may produce burden or information loss.

anchor.note: p.105 l.Lines 57-59 read as the printed page; section 5.2 agrees

public.text: The LIMR is said to ensure that data is machine-processable rather than locked in free text. Clinical free text remains valuable, and forcing all relevant information into structured models may produce burden or information loss.
public.suggestedRevision: State that the LIMR supports consistent structured data where appropriate, while governed use of documents and narrative text remains necessary. Include provenance and appropriate methods for extracting structured information from narrative content.
